The following events took place in '''167 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Darth Tenebrous's Sith Master|Sith Master]] of [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] opened a small rend in the fabric of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], allowing the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to be felt by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], Chapter 5</ref>
*Darth Tenebrous slew his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] and took the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] as his apprentice, christening him [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="The Tenebrous Way">{{InsiderCite|130|The Tenebrous Way}}</ref>
*The planet [[Dra III]] was reclaimed for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the Republic scout [[Barosa Warren]]. {{C|Approximate date, placed sometime between '''167 BBY''' and '''[[57 BBY/Legends|57]] BBY'''}}<ref name="AIR" />
*The planet [[Theal]] was reclaimed for the Galactic Republic by the Republic scout Barosa Warren. {{C|Approximate date, placed sometime between '''167 BBY''' and '''57 BBY'''}}<ref name="AIR" />
*The planet [[Frewwil]] was reclaimed for the Galactic Republic by the Republic scout Barosa Warren. {{C|Approximate date, placed sometime between '''167 BBY''' and '''57 BBY'''}}<ref name="AIR" />
*The planet [[Buamlon Central]] was reclaimed for the Galactic Republic by the Republic scout Barosa Warren. {{C|Approximate date, placed sometime between '''167 BBY''' and '''57 BBY'''}}<ref name="AIR" />
